_doc: You write the master (en). A strong model derives the other languages. No pitch, no numbers, no flattery; one personal hook from the dossier. Placeholders: {first_name} {hook} {my_name} {my_company}.

request.en: Hi {first_name}, {hook} I would value 15 minutes with you at the event to hear your view and see whether there is a fit. Looking forward, {my_name}
request.de: Hallo {first_name}, {hook} Ich würde mich über 15 Minuten mit Ihnen am Anlass freuen, um Ihre Sicht zu hören und zu sehen, ob es passt. Beste Grüsse, {my_name}
